name: Tim Dooley Atlas — Unified Manifest
purpose: The canonical map of the repository. Internal datasets remain modular, but the atlas presents them as one system with stable layers, routes, record identity, relationships, entanglement and evidence.
principle: One atlas, many layers. Records are the objects; relationships explain how they connect; entanglement explains coupling, topology and trajectory; evidence explains what is known; architecture explains where things belong.

architecture.rule: The architecture is a project-defined interpretive frame; it does not convert metaphor into empirical evidence.

architecture.label: Architecture
architecture.purpose: Canonical Frame, Tree, Axis terrain and information architecture.

graph.label: Graph
graph.purpose: Canonical records and explicit relationships joining the archive.

world.label: World
world.purpose: Canonical 195-nation world layer and geographic, institutional and social enrichment.

research.label: Evidence
research.purpose: Facts, sources, events and research material with provenance and explicit missing-data states.

systems.label: Systems
systems.purpose: Economic, energy, infrastructure, technology, labour, finance and strategic-system studies.

emotion.label: Emotion and State
emotion.purpose: Comparative study of emotion, action tendencies, psychological phases and Hawkins' interpretive consciousness model.

mythology.label: Potatoism
mythology.purpose: Project mythology, symbols, interpretive architecture and the Potato research programme, kept distinct from empirical evidence.

relational_dynamics.label: Entanglement and Dynamics
relational_dynamics.purpose: Cross-domain relation structure, topology, terrain, trajectories, phases and outcomes.

canonical_world.enrichment_status: partial — country overlays exist, but they are not counted as empirically enriched until validated observations with provenance are present.

count_definitions.core_atlas_records: nodes + tree-child records + tree-support records; navigational core, not repository file count.
count_definitions.relationships: explicit records in data/relationships.json plus evidence-derived relationships in data/evidence/relationships.json.
count_definitions.entanglements: relationships annotated with coupling, dependency, feedback, topology or trajectory fields; quantum entanglement remains a separate physical concept.
count_definitions.evidence_facts: facts in data/research.json plus normalized observations in data/evidence/observations.json.
count_definitions.sources: source records referenced by research/event/country evidence layers.
count_definitions.enriched_nations: canonical nations with validated sourced observations, not merely an existing enrichment filename.
count_definitions.missing_data: fields explicitly identified as researched_missing or not_researched; missing is never treated as zero.

maintenance_rule: Audit → fix bugs → remove duplicates and unnecessary paths → lock canonical ownership → validate → ingest sourced data → normalize identities and relationships → model entanglement → update views → update manifests → audit again. Do not expand a broken or duplicated layer.

compatibility.status: backend.json remains the machine health/endpoint registry; atlas-manifest.json is the human-facing canonical map.

retirement_policy: Do not delete a legacy dataset merely because another layer overlaps it. First establish a canonical owner, migrate consumers, mark the old file compatibility-only, then remove it only when no live route depends on it.
rule: Never require the user to understand the backend file structure before they can understand the project. The website is the map; the JSON files are the machinery beneath it.
